Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, College of Engineering, Seoul National University
Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, College of Engineering, Seoul National University
Guidelines for Writing the Bachelor's Thesis
When writing your 4th-year bachelor's thesis, please follow the attached writing guidelines.
blocks.ko: 4학년 학사 학위논문을 작성하는데 별첨 작성지침을 참고하여 학위논문을 작성하여 주시기 바랍니다.

blocks.en: 1. Things to know when writing the thesis
blocks.ko: 1. 논문 작성 시 알아 둘 사항

blocks.en: 1) Each student must submit their own thesis (not one thesis per lab group).
Even if you work on the same project, discuss each person's role or the discussion section, and write your own thesis.
blocks.ko: 같은 Project를 수행하더라도 각자 역할 분담 또는 Discussion 등을 논의하여 논문을 작성할 것.

blocks.en: 2) The thesis should be about 10–30 pages long on A4 paper.
blocks.ko: 2) 논문 Page 수는 A4용지 기준으로 10-30 Page정도의 량으로 작성할 것.

blocks.en: 3) Binding is not required, but the thesis must be submitted in the form of a book.
blocks.ko: 3) 제본은 하지 않아도 되나 책과 같은 모양으로 만들어서 제출할 것.

blocks.en: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, College of Engineering, Seoul National University
Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, College of Engineering, Seoul National University
Guidelines for Writing the Bachelor's Thesis
1. Purpose of the guidelines

The purpose of these guidelines is to standardise the format of the thesis so that it is consistent. For matters not stated here, the author decides within the range of common practice, under the guidance of the thesis review committee.
blocks.ko: 본 규정의 목적은 논문의 서식을 일관성 있도록 표준화하기 위한 것으로, 명시되어 있지 않은 사항에 대해서는 통용되는 상식의 범위 내에서 논문심사위원회의 지도하에 논문 작성자의 판단에 의한다.

blocks.en: 2. How to print the forms
A. Outer cover (Attachment 1)
* Follow Article 8 of the Degree Conferral Regulations. The font size of the thesis title is 21 points, and all other text is 16 points. (1 point is 1/72 inch.)
blocks.ko: * 학위수여규정 제 8조에 의하되, 논문제목의 글자크기는 21포인트로 하며, 기타의 글자크기는 16포인트로 한다. (1포인트는 1/72 인치임).

blocks.en: For a thesis written in Korean, Korean (Hangul), Chinese characters and English may be used together.
blocks.ko: 국문으로 작성된 논문의 경우 한글, 한자, 영문을 혼용할 수 있다.

blocks.en: For a thesis written in a foreign language, both the foreign-language title and the Korean title must be given. In this case, put the Korean title in brackets, in 16-point font.
blocks.ko: 외국어로 작성된 논문의 경우 외국어제목과 국문제목을 병기하여야 한다. 이 경우 국문제목은 괄호 안에 넣으며, 글자크기는 16포인트로 한다.

blocks.en: * Write the year of publication of the thesis.
e.g. If the thesis is approved in the second semester (후기, August graduation) of 2024, write "August 2024".
blocks.ko: 예) ‘24년도 후기 논문 통과 시 2024년 8월로 표기

blocks.en: * Arrange all items on the outer cover so that they are balanced left and right around the centre line.
blocks.ko: * 외표지에 기재되는 모든 사항은 중앙선을 중심으로 좌우 균형되게 배열한다.

blocks.en: B. Approval page (Attachment 2)
* Follow Article 8 of the Degree Conferral Regulations.
* The thesis approval date must show the year, month and day on which the advisor signed.
blocks.ko: * 논문인준일은 지도교수가 Sign한 년 월 일까지 표시한다.

blocks.en: 3. Order of contents and how to write the thesis
blocks.ko: 3. 논문 기재 순수 및 논문 작성요령

blocks.en: A. Order of contents
* If the main text is written in Korean
Outer cover, approval page, Korean abstract, table of contents, main text, references, (appendix), English abstract
blocks.ko: 외표지, 인준지, 국문초록, 목차, 본문, 참고문헌, (부록), 영문초록

blocks.en: * If the main text is written in a foreign language
Outer cover, approval page, English abstract, table of contents, main text, references, (appendix), Korean abstract
blocks.ko: 외표지, 인준지, 영문초록, 목차, 본문, 참고문헌, (부록), 국문초록

blocks.en: In the order above, the items in brackets may be left out.
blocks.ko: 위의 기재순서에서 괄호안의 내용은 포함되지 않아도 좋다.

blocks.en: B. How to write the abstract (Attachment 3)
* Write the abstract following the rules for the main text.
* Keywords must be words or phrases that briefly express the central content of the thesis.
blocks.ko: * 주요어(Keywords)는 논문에 포함되어 있는 중심적 내용을 함축성 있게 나타낼 수 있는 어(語), 구(句)를 사용하여야 한다.

blocks.en: * Choose up to 6 words that can be used as index terms when searching for the thesis, and list them at the end of the abstract.
blocks.ko: * 주요어는 논문을 검색할 때 색인어로 가능한 단어를 6개 이내로 선정하여 초록 끝에 나열하여야 한다.

blocks.en: * Write the keywords in Korean under the Korean abstract and in English under the English abstract.
blocks.ko: * 주요어는 국문초록 밑에는 국문으로, 영문초록 밑에는 영문으로 작성하여야 한다.

blocks.en: * List the keywords starting with the one that best represents the topic of the thesis.
blocks.ko: * 주요어는 논문의 주제를 가장 잘 나타낼 수 있는 것부터 나열하여야 한다.

blocks.en: C. How to write the main text (Attachment 4)
* Use only the front side of each page.
* As a rule, the font size is 10 points for Korean and 11 points for English.
blocks.ko: * 글자크기는 국문의 경우 10포인트, 영문의 경우 11포인트로 하는 것을 원칙으로 한다.

blocks.en: * Write the main text with double spacing.
blocks.ko: * 본문은 두 줄 띄기(double spacing)를 기준으로 작성한다.

blocks.en: * Put page numbers at the bottom centre. Use lowercase Roman numerals from the abstract to the list of tables, and Arabic numerals from the main text to the acknowledgements.
blocks.ko: * 페이지는 하단 중앙에 표기하며, 초록부터 표 목차까지 로마자 소문자로, 본문부터 감사문까지는 아라비아 숫자로 표기한다.

blocks.en: * Write notes with single spacing. Do not add headers or footers other than notes.
blocks.ko: * 주는 한 줄 띄기(single spacing)를 기준으로 작성하며, 주를 제외한 머리말과 꼬릿말은 넣지 않는다.

blocks.en: * In the main text, cite references with square brackets at the relevant place, using the same font size as the main text.
blocks.ko: * 본문에서의 참고문헌 인용은 해당 부분에 대괄호로 표시하며 본문과 같은 크기의 글자를 사용한다.

blocks.en: D. How to make figures and tables (Attachments 5, 6)
* Write figure and table titles in Korean if the main text is in Korean, and in the foreign language if the main text is in a foreign language.
blocks.ko: * 그림 및 표의 제목은 본문이 국문인 경우는 국문으로, 외국어인 경우는 외국어로 한다.

blocks.en: * If a figure or table title is not in English, add the English title below it.
blocks.ko: * 그림 및 표의 제목이 영문이 아닌 경우 제목 하단에 영문을 병기한다.

blocks.en: * If a figure or table title (which may include a description) is one line, centre it; if it is two or more lines, use the same margins as the main text. Place the title below a figure and above a table.
blocks.ko: * 그림 및 표의 제목(설명도 포함될 수 있음)은 한 줄인 경우에는 중앙에, 두 줄 이상인 경우에는 본문과 같은 여백을 두고 작성하되 그림의 경우에는 하단에, 표의 경우에는 상단에 위치하도록 한다.

blocks.en: E. How to write the references (Attachment 7)
* Write the references following the rules for the main text.
* List only references that are cited in the main text.
blocks.ko: * 참고문헌은 반드시 본문에서 인용한 것만을 기재한다.

blocks.en: * Write each reference in the following order.
blocks.ko: * 각 참고문헌의 기재순서는 다음과 같이 한다.

blocks.en: - Journal paper: author name(s), 'title', journal name, volume, issue, pages, month, year
blocks.ko: - 논문지: 저자명, ‘제목’, 잡지명, 권, 호, 쪽수, 월, 연도

blocks.en: - Book: author name(s), book title, publisher, place of publication, pages, year
blocks.ko: - 단행본: 저자명, 도서명, 출판사명, 소재지, 쪽수, 연도

english: 1. Students expected to graduate in February 2027 should refer to the attached graduation thesis writing guidelines and submit their thesis to the department administrative office by the deadline.
(1) Who must submit: Among students who have applied to graduate in February 2027, those with a primary major or a double major (including the College of Liberal Studies (자유전공학부))
※ A graduation thesis cannot be submitted on its own without graduating.
(2) Graduation thesis submission deadline: by 21 Dec 2026 (Mon)
* Even if your thesis is already written, do not submit it early; please submit it from December onward.)
(3) Please write your student ID number in pencil at the bottom of the thesis cover.
* Double major students and College of Liberal Studies students should write 복수 (double major) or 자유 (Liberal Studies) in pencil in front of the student ID number.
(4) No separate binding is needed (the department office will bind all theses together later).
Both double-sided and single-sided printing are accepted. (However, the outer cover and the approval page (인준지) must each be printed single-sided.)
2. Students who unavoidably cannot submit their graduation thesis by the deadline should submit the Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation Form (졸업논문제출일 확인서; form attached)
by 21 Dec 2026 (Mon) to the staff member in charge, 박주연 (Park Ju-yeon), in Room 319, Building 301.
(1) The thesis submission deadline under the Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation Form is 28 Dec 2026 (Mon).
(2) The Thesis Submission Date Confirmation Form must be submitted by 21 Dec 2026 (Mon), and the thesis must be submitted by 28 Dec (Mon).
(1) Outer cover: write the date as 2027.2
(2) Approval page (인준지): write the year, month and day on which your thesis supervisor signed it

4. Students who previously submitted a report when completing the graduation project must also write their thesis following the attached graduation thesis template, have it signed by their thesis supervisor, and submit it.
